offering_description.value: Leases Gamma Knife radiosurgery systems and related equipment to hospitals and cancer centers on a per-use fee basis, and operates them so hospitals can offer noninvasive brain and body treatments to patients.

primary_services.value: radiosurgery treatment services; equipment operation and maintenance; proton therapy services

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and cancer treatment centers that host the equipment

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-procedure fees paid by hospitals for each radiosurgery treatment performed

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs radiosurgery units placed in hospitals, sold to hospitals and their patients; service provider: staffs and maintains treatment systems for host hospitals

geography_served.value: US national: hospital sites across many US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on radiosurgery and related radiation therapy equipment services for hospitals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts negotiated directly with hospitals and cancer centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: radiation-emitting treatment equipment under FDA device rules and state radiation facility licensing, plus Medicare and hospital billing rules

notes: Proton therapy service details and current business mix are uncertain and may have changed.
